name: Explaining Death To Children
overview: Scripture teaches that death entered the world as a result of sin through Adam, affecting all humanity because all have sinned (Romans 5:12). Yet, death is not the end for believers, as God values the death of His saints and promises eternal life through faith in His Son (Psalms 116:15; John 3:16). Ultimately, God will remove all sorrow, pain, and death, ushering in a new reality where these former things have passed away (Revelation 21:4). This truth provides a foundation for explaining death to children with hope rooted in Christ’s redemptive work and the promise of eternal life.
